goal: Answer practical questions clearly: working hours and shifts, moving or travelling, and when you can start.

meaning.roman: Mujhe ... kaam karne mein koi masla nahi.

phrases.example: I am comfortable working evening shifts.

meaning.roman: Main ... se kaam shuru kar sakta/sakti hoon.

phrases.example: I can start from the first of next month.
My notice period is one month.
I would need two weeks to move to a new city.

roleplay.tutor_line: This job has rotating shifts, including evenings. Is that a problem for you?

task.roman: Shift ke baare mein apni sachchi rai batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: I am comfortable working evening shifts. I can arrange my travel.

roleplay.tutor_line: The office is in another city. Would you be able to move?

task.roman: Agar aap ko dusre shehr jana ho to apna jawab batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: I would need two weeks to move to a new city. After that, I can work from the office every day.

task.roman: Batayein ke aap kab se kaam shuru kar sakte hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I can start from the first of next month.

roleplay.tutor_line: Are you working now? What is your notice period?

task.roman: Agar aap abhi kaam kar rahe hain to notice period batayein; warna kahein ke aap free hain.

roleplay.model_answer: My notice period is one month. If you need me earlier, I can talk to my manager.

roleplay.tutor_line: Would you be able to travel for work sometimes?

task.roman: Kaam ke liye kabhi kabhi safar ke baare mein apna jawab dein.

roleplay.model_answer: I am comfortable working outside the office sometimes. I would need a few days to plan my travel.

review_notes: These are common practical questions, but employers differ. Is there anything else in your experience that learners should be ready for (transport, working on Saturdays, a probation period)?
